jobs.occupation: Life Scientist (m/w/d) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: At the Max Planck Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences, we bridge the gap between basic research and translational, preclinical approaches. Here, researchers from the fields of biology, chemistry, physics, and medicine collaborate across disciplines, supported by high-performance service facilities and a modern research infrastructure. As the largest institute of the Max Planck Society, with around 1,000 employees from more than 66 nations, we offer an inspiring, international working environment with exceptional scientific breadth.The research group Ubiquitin Signaling Specificity (Dr. Sonja Lorenz) invites applications for the position asPostdoc (f/m/d)- Cryo-EM Analyses of Ubiquitin Ligase Complexes - Our laboratory aims to understand how the posttranslational modifier ubiquitin coordinates eukaryotic physiology. A major key lies in the action of ubiquitin ligases that recruit specific substrates for ubiquitination and determine which ubiquitin signals they are decorated with. The immense potential of ubiquitin ligases for therapeutic applications has been illustrated by the clinical efficacy of immunomodulatory drugs in the treatment of hematological malignancies and recent advances with PROTACs and molecular glues. However, efficient targeting of ubiquitin ligases in the clinic is still limited by our insufficient understanding of their structural mechanisms, regulation, and integration into cellular pathways.We offer a Postdoc position focusing on revealing structural mechanisms of specificity, regulation, and substrate recognition by ubiquitin ligases. Available projects center on cryo-EM as a principle structural tool, but may also integrate other structural techniques, including X-ray crystallography, as well as biophysical and biochemical analyses of enzymatic activities and protein interactions. For a representative example of our integrated research approach, please seeNat Struct Mol Biol. 2024 Feb;31(2):364-377. doi: 10.1038/s41594-023-01203-4Candidates should hold/soon expect a PhD or equivalent degree in a relevant area of the life sciences. A strong published track record in single-particle cryo-EM (or cryo-ET) and in protein biochemistry is essential. The successful candidate should be curiosity-driven, creative, and passionate about science. A high degree of self-motivation and independence is important, as well as the ability to communicate well within an international, multidisciplinary team. The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extension. Remuneration is based on the TVöD Bund (German federal civil service pay scale), depending on qualifications and professional experience. In addition, public sector social benefits apply.We are committed to being a cosmopolitan institute that offers a diverse and inclusive working environment with equal opportunities. We also aim to increase the number of employees with disabilities. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.A stimulating and collaborative international research environmentProfessional development opportunities, skills training, and the Max Planck Society’s online training academySupport for balancing work and family life, including on-campus childcare placesCorporate health management, fitness and sports programsspacious on-site cafeteria offering warm meals and a salad barSustainability initiatives and a nature-oriented campus environment, including the BioDiversum biotope projectAbout usBased at one of Germany’s premier research campuses, our research group has access to leading-edge infrastructure in all areas of cell and structural biology, including cryo-EM and superresolution imaging. We are an ambitious international team, supported by the Max Planck Society, the German Research Foundation, among other sources. Our working language is English; knowledge of German is not required. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The Finance Controller is also responsible for the continuous development of the local controlling organization. SOX) is embedded in line with the global model, including controls operated outside Finance (e.g. Supply Chain), and drive remediation where controls are not operating - Proactively lead the risk management agenda, ensuring high-quality risk assessments and appropriate mitigation - Ensure accurate and timely group and local statutory reporting, own the integrity of the DACH balance sheets, including timely substantiation and resolution of material exposures, and ensure high-quality delivery across Record to Report, Procure to Pay and Order to Cash - Continuously improve accounting quality, implement changes in group & local standards and establish the local processes required for reporting in the planned combined business, working with the central Reporting & Accounting Operations team to upskill local teams (e.g. lease accounting under US GAAP) - Oversee statutory accounting, filing and governance requirements for the DACH legal entities, including Supervisory Board papers, in coordination with local directors, auditors, Tax, Legal, Treasury and Pension specialists - Oversee Treasury operations and local bank relations in line with the Global Treasury Standard, and implement required risk control and insurance standards - Act as a trusted adviser to DACH Finance and business leadership on accounting, reporting, risk and control matters, providing constructive challenge, translating complex topics into clear recommendations and holding senior stakeholders to account for timely resolution of risks - Lead, coach and develop the local Controlling team, setting clear priorities, accountabilities and performance expectations - Build capability in accounting, US GAAP, statutory reporting, SOX and risk management, and foster a culture of ownership, integrity and continuous improvement  REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - 8+ years of Finance experience, including financial accounting, reporting and controls in an international organisation - Strong expertise in financial accounting, internal controls and risk management, including SOX or comparable control frameworks - US GAAP experience, or the ability to implement US GAAP requirements with specialist support - Strong knowledge of German statutory accounting and governance requirements, with a working understanding of tax matters - Good understanding of German pension accounting, reporting and governance requirements - Experience managing internal and external audits and driving remediation of findings - Proven people leadership, including delivering outcomes through cross-functional stakeholders - Strong judgement and clear communication, with the ability to explain complex financial matters to non-Finance audiences - Fluency in German and English  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - A recognised professional accounting qualification (e.g. CA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent) - Experience across Germany, Switzerland and Austria - SAP S/4HANA experience WHAT WE OFFER YOU:- flexible hours and the option for remote work- 30 days of vacation plus December 24th and 31st off- Meal allowance: €65 per month- Access to Manager Check‑Ups – Optional executive‑level health screenings to support long‑term well‑being and performance- Company pension & shares- In-house café: snacks, lunch, and coffee specialties at discounted prices- ·Discounts via Corporate Benefits- Deutschland Ticket: €50 monthly subsidy or a discounted company bike- Free training opportunities and access to our own learning platform- E-GYM/Wellpass for €20 per month & free corporate health management & a 24/7 counseling service- And the best for last – unlimited ice cream!ARE YOU INTERESTED?Great! At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! jobs.description: Du möchtest hoch hinaus? Wir bieten Dir die Möglichkeit dazu!Als Weltmarktführer im Bereich Windenergie verantwortet Vestas den Service an den innovativsten Windenergieanlagen und bietet dir viele Möglichkeiten für deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Als Servicetechniker (m/w/d) erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in der Welt der Erneuerbaren Energien!Service>Service Offshore NCE>Service DK & DE>Deutsche BuchtDie Vestas Service Offshore Organisation ist für alle Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit dem Betrieb und der Wartung von Offshore-Windparks in Nord- und Mitteleuropa verantwortlich.Wir suchen engagierte Mitarbeiter die zukünftig den Offshore-Betrieb unserer Windenergieanlagen im Offshore-Windpark Nordseecluster, bestehend aus 104 V236 Windturbinen mit jeweils 15 MW und einer resultierenden Gesamtkapazität von über 1,5 GW, sicherstellen.Du wirst eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem Serviceteam übernehmen. Zeitweilige Reisen zu anderen Offshore-Windparks innerhalb von Vestas zur Schulung, Weiterbildung und zum Erfahrungsaustausch sind ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Position. Als Offshore-Servicetechniker (w/m/d) arbeitest du in einem Team von drei oder mehr Technikern und sorgst für einen reibungslosen und zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Windenergieanlagen.Deine Vorteile – Weil du es wert bist!- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag für Sicherheit und Perspektive, sofortiger Einstieg- Top-Weiterbildung in der Vestas Academy, inklusive Qualifizierung zur Elektrofachkraft nach DIN-VDE 0105-100- Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum- Intensive Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Schulungen- Arbeiten am Puls der Zeit – modernste Windenergietechnologie und innovative Lösungen- Kostenlose hochwertige Ausrüstung – alles, was du für deine Einsätze brauchst- Modernste Unterbringung auf einem SOV - inkusive Kino, Fitnessstudios und Sauna- Vollständige Verpflegung während deiner Offshore-Schicht- Attraktive Benefits: Business Bike, Fitnessstudio-Zulage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge- Überstundenkonto und Möglichkeit zum Sabbatical- Keine Langeweile – jeder Tag ist anders- Wertschätzung und ein starkes Team in internationaler Arbeitsatmosphäre– wir halten zusammen- Menschlichkeit und Vielfalt – wir sind ein Team und setzen auf eine offene und wertschätzende Du-Kultur Deine Mission- Pack mit an!- Wartung und Reparatur von elektrischen und mechanischen Systemen- Störungsbeseitigung an elektrischen und mechanischen Systemen- Fehlerdiagnose- Durchführung einer Vielzahl von Überprüfungen, Reparaturen und Austausch von Turbinenkomponenten- Einhaltung von HSE-Standards- Erstellen von Folgeaufträgen und Erfassen des Zeit- und Materialverbrauchs in SAP Dein Profil – du bringst mit!- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektriker (m/w/d)- Vorzugsweise bereits Wind- und/oder Offshore-Erfahrungen gesammelt (kein Muss)- Gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift- Grundkenntnisse in Microsoft OfficeBEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUDIt has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process DEIB StatementAt Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future. About VestasVestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 173 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.With 29,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels.
